q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of absorbent cotton wool per kg?
title: Absorbent cotton carbon footprint per kg
short: Start with the cotton fibre or comber noil per kg and its supplier figure, then add opening, scouring, bleaching, drying and carding energy. Divide the unit's fuel and electricity by kg packed.

ul: Cotton fibre or comber noil by weight.
Kier boiling and bleaching with steam.
Rolling, cutting, sterilising if required, and packing.

p: Report per kg, then per roll by roll weight. Steam for bleaching and drying is often the largest plant energy use.

example.title: Worked example: absorbent cotton unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 86,800 / 60,000 = 1.447 kg CO2 per kg
Add cotton fibre for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
